newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Bolger says must compromise to form coalition.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Bolger says must compromise to form coalition.

text.p: Prime Minister Jim Bolger speaking to Radio New Zealand on Tuesday about New Zealand's 0-2 percent inflation target said some compromise was necessary to form a coalition.
"In negotiating to form a coaltion government, clearly compromise in some of those positions are essential if we are to form a coalition."

Commenting on Finance Minister Bill Birch's comment on Monday that the 0-2 percent inflation target may well be on the table in coalition talks between the National Party and New Zealand First, Bolger said: "We are really debating around the
"We are now running at about 0-2.5 percent if we take the actual figures that are coming out."
